# Upstream reference

Christopher Batty, SDFGen (https://github.com/christopherbatty/SDFGen).

Upstream README states MIT License; the upstream code is not bundled here.
This starter's `src/sdfgen_style.cpp` is an independent teaching implementation
with the same high-level algorithmic structure, not an upstream byte-identical copy.
For stricter fidelity testing, check out a pinned commit of upstream SDFGen and
run both with identical fixed grid configuration before course release.
